description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 2530015365744 ACCUMULATOR,HYDRAUL: Line 0001 Qty 17 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0073 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract). The Guaranteed Minimum quantity will be 2. Items will be shipped to various CONUS and OCONUS (via consolidation and containerization point) DLA Depots. Approved sources are 6N039 61480001A; 75Q65 3511398. The solicitation is an RFQ and will be available at the link provided in this notice. Hard copies of this solicitation are not available. Specifications, plans, or drawings are not available. All responsible sources may submit a quote which, if timely received, shall be considered. Quotes must be submitted electronically.
